name: Lease Agreement
description: Risk checklist for commercial and residential leases.

categories.name: Rent and payment
categories.description: Flag rent escalation clauses without caps, late payment penalties that exceed legal limits, or additional fees (CAM, maintenance) that are undefined or uncapped.

categories.name: Term and renewal
categories.description: Flag auto-renewal without adequate notice periods, early termination penalties that are disproportionate, or lock-in periods with no break clause.

categories.name: Maintenance and repairs
categories.description: Flag tenant responsibility for structural repairs, ambiguous maintenance obligations, or lack of landlord obligation to maintain habitability.

categories.name: Security deposit
categories.description: Flag deposits exceeding legal limits, vague conditions for deposit return, or deductions allowed for normal wear and tear.

categories.name: Use restrictions
categories.description: Flag overly restrictive use clauses that limit business operations, or exclusive use provisions that could be violated by the landlord leasing to competitors.

categories.name: Liability and insurance
categories.description: Flag requirements for disproportionate insurance, tenant assumption of all liability including structural issues, or waiver of landlord liability for negligence.
